completeness_notes: A connected still life with more than four cells cannot contain a live 2x2 block, so the block-free language is necessary at population 152.
All tied physical depth-five corner patches are enumerated; the certificate does not rely on one representative patch per abstract mapping.
All valid adjacent depth-five edges are allowed at every lifted corner, even when they do not belong to the same equality path. This enlarges the language and makes a negative result safe.
The calculation is confined to fixed local boundary languages and a four-side transfer; it is not a full-board CP-SAT or brute-force search.

consequence.logic: Any block-free board with total W=38 projects to a depth-five minimum ring and has zero added sixth-layer wastage. It must therefore occur in this safe lift language. If the language has no four-cycle of cost <=38, no such board exists.

anchored_four_cycle_test.proof: Every four-cycle of total cost <=K has at least one arc of cost <=floor(K/4). All such arcs are anchors. Exact two-step and three-step min-plus returns test every cycle containing an anchor.

method: Complete depth-five equality-arc support; every tied physical 6x6 corner patch at a supported minimum mapping; safe all-edge adjacency overapproximation; exact zero-new-wastage depth-six straight graph; anchored four-side min-plus exclusion.
